name: Stability Ball Hamstring Curl
steps: Lie on your back with your heels on top of an exercise ball.
Rest your arms on the floor out to the sides.
Lift your hips so your body is straight from shoulders to heels.
Bend your knees to roll the ball toward you.
Roll it back out slowly, keeping hips up.
cues: Squeeze the backs of your thighs

common_mistakes.fix: Squeeze glutes to keep hips high
Keep heels together in the middle of the ball
